OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"document":{"type":"document_url","url":"https://example.com/multipage.pdf"},"model":"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.ocr(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.pages);
    println!("{:?}", result.pages[0].index);
    println!("{:?}", result.pages[1].index);
}
```
